(
  set -e
  cd /Users/yosomi/Code/nuinuiCAD

  base=b29186a6a8f48d35f60ab6adb334a3defe7d4a6a

  npm run build
  npm run lint
  npm test -- --maxWorkers=2
  npm run test:parity
  npm run docs:dsl:check
  git diff --check "$base" HEAD
  git diff --check

  if {
    git diff --name-only "$base" HEAD
    git diff --name-only
  } | grep -q '^rust-evaluator/'; then
    cargo fmt \
      --manifest-path rust-evaluator/Cargo.toml -- --check
    cargo check \
      --manifest-path rust-evaluator/Cargo.toml
    cargo test \
      --manifest-path rust-evaluator/Cargo.toml
    cargo clippy \
      --manifest-path rust-evaluator/Cargo.toml \
      --all-targets -- -D warnings
  fi
)
